# Core features

## Available

- Accounts: a waiting list on the landing page, invitations by mail from an admin page or
  the command line, sign-in, sign-out, password reset by mail.
- The planner page with a map and an empty trip list.

## Planned

- Trips as a sequence of days; a day as a sequence of stops at places, with one or more
  routes between consecutive stops.
- Places kept once per trip: hotels, restaurants, fuel stops, sights, with address,
  contact, booking reference and notes.
- Stops with a role, an arrival time, a pause and an optional flag.
- Routes drawn on the map and routed along roads by OSRM, or straight, with undo and redo,
  recalculation and an optional flag; or imported as GPX tracks or routes, Garmin's
  calculated route points included.
- A computed timeline per day: departure, arrival at each stop, slack or conflict against
  fixed arrival times, distance and riding time.
- A library of the user's trips with copy, move, duplicate and reorder for days, stops,
  routes and places.
- GPX export by scope (trip, days, day, route), packaging (one file, one per day, zip),
  geometry (tracks, routes with their points, both), waypoints (stops or none) and the
  handling of optional routes; naming patterns and saved presets.
- Photos, receipts and documents attached to the trip, a day, a stop, a route or a place;
  photos placed by their EXIF time and position; comments for notes before and after the
  trip.
- A read-only trip page for printing and sharing.
- A base map switcher; light and dark interface.
